Name: (CP and AT) Lovely Fences
Author: CelestiaSelene
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Ekg0sqq.png[/img]
﻿[color=#ff9c8e][size=4]This is a mod that modifies all 4 of the fence types to be more cute and girly!
I have been wanting fences that were more my style and decided to
just make my own to get back into modern modding.
They only need to be crafted and placed after installation if using CP.
If you're using AT you will need to purchase a paint brush/bucket from Robin first!
Please let me know if there are any issues!

[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ are required for this mod to work![/b]

[/size][size=2](Note: If you have the CP version of Lovely Fences installed SMAPI and/or Stardrop will tell you that there's an update.
The update is only for the AT version but Nexus doesn't recognize that they're separate versions.
If this bothers you, please open the manifest.json file and change the version number to 2.1.1. This should get it to leave you alone.
Otherwise it's safe to ignore it.
This won't be an issue in any future updates for Lovely Fences.)[/size][size=4]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6TE5q72.png[/img]
[/size][/color]
[color=#ff9c8e][size=4]❤ Updating my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/154]pink house mod[/url]﻿ for 1.6.[/size][/color]
[color=#ff9c8e][size=4]❤ Creating the other house stages. [/size][/color]
[color=#ff9c8e][size=4]❤ Creating seasonal versions of these fences (if there's interest.)[/size][/color]
[color=#ff9c8e][size=4]❤ Creating matching paths.[/size][/color]
[color=#ff9c8e][size=4]❤ Other color schemes (if there's interest or requests for other colors.)[/size][/color]
[color=#ff9c8e][size=4][s]❤ Alternative Textures version.[/s][/size][/color]
[color=#ff9c8e][size=4]
(Not in order!)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4utifMM.png[/img]

Huge thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/r1kai/]r1kai[/url]﻿ for help with getting these working in Content Patcher!
Outfit is from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/114622928]luoli1119[/url]﻿ and hair and accessories are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20146]blight[/url]﻿!
Not required but a mod that I use and love is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20802]No Fence Decay Redux[/url]﻿!
That way you can use the fences without constant repairing!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BRmT8RD.png[/img]
[b]❤ 4/18/2024: ❤[/b]
A version for Alternative Textures has been added!
It's one of the other files so please make sure you're downloading the correct one from the files tab.
[b]❤ 4/20/2024: ❤[/b]
Update to the CP version of the mod to patch onto springobjects.png rather than replacing it fully.
Update to both the CP and AT version to fix an issue with the stone gate when it's open.
[b]❤ 4/21/2024: ❤[/b]
Fixed an issue with the stone gate again in the AT version. :')
[/size][/color][/center]
